text:
Alex Chen: quick heads-up — planning a staged rollout for smart routing that routes by customer tier+region and falls back to smaller model variants when capacity spikes. main worry: tokenizer/tool-calling parity breaking for higher-tier customers. need a short sanity walk before canary. any quick blockers?
Maria Patel: +1. we should enumerate parity dims: tokenizer vocab/tokenization behavior, special tokens, context-length truncation semantics, tool metadata & signature compatibility, and structured output formats. also decide which dims are dealbreakers vs degradations.
Jon Gómez: telemetry needs: record fallback_decision events with from_model,to_model,reason,tier,region. also instrument tool_call_failure_reason when a tool call fails due to model mismatch. sample event payload for instrumentation:```json
{"event":"fallback_decision","from":"redwood-3b","to":"redwood-1b-q8","reason":"burst_capacity","tier":"enterprise","region":"us-west-2"}
```
Samir Desai: quota question — smaller variants may produce more tokens for same prompt (different tokenizers or truncation). billing/quotas must not silently penalize customers. propose adding a quota_scaling_factor per variant in router so usage account = token_count * scaling_factor. quick config example:```yaml
router_rules:
  - name: tier_fallback_v2
    fallback_policy: region_then_variant
    variant_scaling:
      redwood-3b: 1.0
      redwood-1b-q8: 1.05
```
Priya Rao: from console/rollout UX POV we need two things: a per-customer "compatibility advisory" shown on the account page (opt-in/opt-out for fallback) and a rollout dashboard widget that shows %requests routed to fallbacks by tier+region. also expose a preview of the compatibility matrix for support.
DevExBot: deploybot: canary roll initiated for routing-rule tier_fallback_v2 in us-west-2 :rocket:
infra-bot: note: capacity spike expected on gpu-pool-2 tonight, might trigger fallbacks automatically. we should coordinate windows.
Rachel Kim: proposed quick triage plan: 1) tokenizer roundtrip test (prompt -> tokenize -> detokenize == original for 95% of cases), 2) tool-call signature smoke (invoke tool metadata + run), 3) context-truncation diffs (feed long prompt and assert behavior), 4) billing sanity check with scaling factor. i'll spin up a Notion doc and link once done. volunteers?
Alex Chen: volunteers: Maria — tokenizer rows; Jon — telemetry/events + dashboards; Samir — quota_scaling changes and billing test; Priya — console flags & opt-out flow; Rachel — test harness + doc. aim: smoke suite + dashboard before 48h canary.
Maria Patel: adding one more nuance — special tokens used in tool-calling (e.g., <tool_start>) must have same codepoints across variants. if not, tool parser will miss triggers. i'll add a quick deterministic check in tokenizer tests.
Jon Gómez: for dashboards, suggest two new metrics: fallback_rate_by_tier (1m,5m), toolcall_failure_rate_by_fallback_pair. will add telemetry mapping and a Grafana dashboard prototype.
Samir Desai: quick note: need to patch usage billing worker to pull variant_scaling from router config else invoice diffs will be messy. i'll open a PR tonight.
Priya Rao: console mock: small banner on customer settings "Your account may be routed to smaller variants during capacity events. Opt out? [button]" plus a small "compatibility report" modal listing known-issues by variant. low friction for enterprise support.
Alex Chen: one more ask — can we make fallback decisions include an explicit "compatibility_score" in the event so console and dashboards can highlight risky fallbacks? eg 0-100.
Jon Gómez: yes, add compatibility_score computed from matrix (Maria's tokenizer tests + toolcall smoke). we'll default to 100 for identical variants, lower when we detect known differences.
Rachel Kim: timeline check — i'll have the test harness and matrix skeleton up in 12 hrs, can run full smoke in ~18 hrs. if everyone owns their parts we can gate canary behind CI smoke pass + minimal dashboard.
DevExBot: ci/pipeline: routing-smoke-tests started by rachel.k — build 4823
Samir Desai: opened PR #5843 (router: add variant_scaling + fallback logging). added unit tests for scaling math.
Maria Patel: pushed tokenizer-check script to infra repo, includes roundtrip and special-token mapping checks. snippet:```bash
python tools/tokenizer_check.py --models redwood-3b redwood-1b-q8 --tokens-file sample_tokens.json
```
Alex Chen: great. if no major objections i'll schedule the canary window for 48h from now and link rollout ticket. thanks all — this thread tracked the short triage we needed. :thumbsup:
